full_judgment:
Md. Joynal Abedin, J.: This appeal by leave by the plaintiff appellant is from the judgment and decree dated 29.11.1993 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 238 of 1991 allowing the appeal and thereby dismissing the suit filed by the plaintiff appellant for refund of Tk. 15,00,000/- being earnest money forfeited by the defendant respondent. 

 4. The trial court, on consideration of the evidence on record, decreed the suit 

 5. The defendant went in appeal being First Appeal No.238 of 1991 to the High Court Division, which set aside the judgment and decree of the trial court.
